## Option B: manual install

Import recipe.json into the bot editor, or paste each skill in `skills/` (the `prize-ledger-lens-engine` and `prize-ledger-domain-engine` skills first) and each fact from [MEMORY.md](MEMORY.md) into a Grok Bot chat. Select `prize-ledger-getting-started` as the first skill. Create routines from [PROMPTS.md](PROMPTS.md) only when you want them, and leave connectors off.

If you do not see an import action for `recipe.json`, use the paste half of the sentence above. Say "Save this as a skill." for each `SKILL.md`. The kit-wide steps are in [INSTALL.md](../../INSTALL.md).

## Option C: other agents

Use [SYSTEM_PROMPT.md](SYSTEM_PROMPT.md) as the system prompt, and give the agent MEMORY.md, PROMPTS.md and the `skills/` folder. Run every command from this template folder with Node 18 or later.

## First run

Run the `prize-ledger-getting-started` skill. It asks one question at a time:

1. Which game, which build, and who produces the evidence pack?
2. Which prizes, entitlements and refund programs are in scope, and who approves exceptions?
3. What source proves fulfillment for each program (an entitlement read, a grant log, a refund receipt), and what is the wait limit?
4. Does this program grant account entitlements only, or does it pay to an address that needs a private address review? If it pays, what address format and mask lengths apply?

Then it checks the install and grades the synthetic worked example:

```sh
node tests/run-all.mjs
node engine/lens.mjs fixtures/good-pack.json
node ledger/scenario.mjs --digest
```

## Local input and review output

Use an owner-prepared JSON journal with packId, gitSha, liveSha, profile, nowMs, deadlineMs, rows and a snapshot of subjectKey and prizeKey pairs. Each row supplies id, prizeKey, subjectKey and history. subjectKey is the kit's salted subject id (sub_ plus 32 lowercase hex); row ids, prize keys and references are short opaque keys. History events carry to, role (agent, owner or evidence-import), at and, when required, a decisionRef or evidence with kind and ref.

You get an evidence pack and a local digest of held, proposed, reported and evidence-backed rows that names what needs the owner's decision. Nothing is granted, paid, refunded or sent.

Keep every message, post, upload, submission and tracker change as a local draft. Only the human reviews and sends, publishes, uploads or files it.

Work only on a working branch. Push only when the human asks and only to that branch. Never push to main. The human merges and deploys. Any feature switch you add is off by default.

## Works with other templates

This template works on its own. When other templates from the kit run in the same game project, they exchange files under `.grokbot-team/artifacts/<artifact>/` (read the newest file) and share an append-only memory under `.grokbot-team/memory/`. Team spec 1.0.0.

Before acting, look for these inputs:

| Input | From | Where to look | If it is missing |
|---|---|---|---|
| `game-profile` (required, ^1.0.0) | the owner | `pack.profile` in the evidence pack, or `.grokbot-team/artifacts/game-profile/` | Ask the getting-started questions and write it with the owner. A missing threshold leaves its line unmeasured, never a default. |
| `evidence-pack` (required, ^1.0.0) | the owner, 02 Playtest, 04 Netcode, 07 Shader, 08 World and Biome, 16 Splat Cleaner | the pack path the owner gives, or `.grokbot-team/artifacts/evidence-pack/` | Stop and ask the owner for a pack. Without one there is no grade; record NOT_RUN. |
| `support-case-draft` (optional, ^1.0.0) | 23 Support Desk | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/support-case-draft/` | Continue without it. Start the report with "ASSUMPTION: no support-case-draft available" and say which checks it would have informed. Leave lines that need it unmeasured. Never invent the missing data. |
| `enforcement-policy-draft` (optional, ^1.0.0) | 15 Server Fairness | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/enforcement-policy-draft/` | Continue without it. Start the report with "ASSUMPTION: no enforcement-policy-draft available" and say which checks it would have informed. Leave lines that need it unmeasured. Never invent the missing data. |

After acting, save these outputs as local files for the human to review:

| Output | Format | Where | Read by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entitlement-ledger` 1.0.0 | JSON plus a text digest draft | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/entitlement-ledger/` | 06 Economy, 22 Live Service, 23 Support Desk, 28 App Store |
| `grade-record` 1.0.0 | JSON (the engine's grade record) | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/grade-record/` | 12 Producer |
| `ticket-draft` 1.0.0 | JSON or Markdown local draft | `.grokbot-team/artifacts/ticket-draft/` | 12 Producer, 18 Bug Desk |

Each output file is JSON with `artifact`, `version`, `producer` (this template's id and version), `createdAt` (UTC), `synthetic` and `items`, as the kit's `spec/artifacts/<artifact>.schema.json` describes. Name files `<UTC date>-<short label>.json` so the newest sorts last.

Shared memory:

- Before acting, read `decisions`, `incidents`, `releases` from `.grokbot-team/memory/<topic>.jsonl`. Skip records that have expired or that a later record supersedes.
- Write only `decisions`, `entitlements`. Append one line per record with `engine/team-memory.mjs` (or the same JSON by hand): id, UTC time, writer (`gbf-24-prize-refund-ledger` and `1.0.0`), topic, kind, summary, data, source, confidence (measured, reported or assumed), expires_at and supersedes. Never edit or delete a line; supersede it.
- Never put secrets, names, handles, wallets, emails or raw user ids in memory. Refer to a person or account only by `node engine/team-memory.mjs hash <id>`, which needs the salt in `GROKBOT_TEAM_SALT`. Run `node engine/team-memory.mjs lint` before you finish.
- Keep `.grokbot-team/` out of a public game repository (add it to `.gitignore`); in a private one, commit it so the append-only rule can be checked against history.
